title: Tesla filed 5 permits at Giga Texas in 60 days, same parcel. DC2-102 CORTEX 2.0 and Cell phase 2 building are the interesting ones.

bodyMarkdown:
I was looking through Austin's permit data and noticed Tesla filed five permits in 60 days for the Giga Texas parcel (TCAD ID 0315410104). They point to two different addresses, but they're on the exact same property.

13101 TESLA RD BLDG GAR (lat 30.2243): 2 ETJ utility permits, both tagged site plan SP-2026-0021.ETJX.

12733 TESLA RD (about 380m northeast, lat 30.2275): 3 building/MEP permits, no SP number in the descriptions.

## Timeline

- 3/18/2026 — "DC2-102 CORTEX 2.0 WET UTILITIES" at 12733. 16" water line, 24" reclaimed water, 12" wastewater process piping.
- 3/18/2026 — "CHP7 DCW to IW Back-flow preventer, 10-inch" at 12733. 200 sqft.
- 4/23/2026 — "Cell phase 2 building" plumbing at 12733. 200,000 sqft new addition. Tesla Energy Operations Inc as direct contractor.
- 5/20/2026 — Fireline at 13101: 2,500 LF of 16/12/6" PVC/DI pipe + FDCs + hydrants. SP-2026-0021. Status: Final.
- 5/20/2026 — Reclaimed water line 5,560 LF + wastewater 5,170 LF at 13101. SP-2026-0021. Contractor: C C Carlton Industries.

## The pattern

Utility permits usually drop before building permits, and that's exactly the pattern we're seeing here over the last 60 days.

## DC2-102 CORTEX 2.0

The "DC2-102 CORTEX 2.0" permit is the big one here. "Cortex 2.0" is Tesla's publicly named next-gen supercluster at Giga Texas. Cortex 1 was the initial ~50K H100 deployment Tesla completed in 2024, which Musk confirmed was "running at full capacity" in June 2025. Cortex 2.0 is the announced ~100K H100/H200 expansion at ~500MW total power, with a phased rollout — 250MW activation targeted for April 2026, scaling to 500MW by mid-year. Tesla has been installing ~150 Megapacks at Giga Texas to power it.

So this "DC2-102 CORTEX 2.0 wet utilities" permit at 12733 is part of the Cortex 2.0 buildout. The timing lines up — utilities going in March, with the 250MW activation targeted April. "DC2-102" probably means Datacenter 2, level/section 102, though that's not officially confirmed.

## Cell phase 2

Right next to it, "Cell phase 2 building" is going up at 200K sqft. This is likely for 4680 cell production phase 2, given that Giga Texas is where Tesla has been scaling that tech. The permit only says "Cell phase 2 building," so it's not officially confirmed yet.

## What to watch

Keep an eye out for actual building permits (not just utilities) popping up on this parcel in the week leading up to Q2 earnings on July 22nd.

The permits are public, all in the sources below. My read: this is the Cortex 2.0 ground prep + 4680 cell line phase 2 going up in parallel.
